description: The user's UpFork profile as they edit it: name, headline, about, skills, languages, networks, experience, the products their page leads with. A developer's is their public page, upfork.dev/developers/<handle>, and their PDF résumé.
name: my_profile

outputSchema.description: The member's profile as they edit it: on their public page (/developers/<handle>) when they're a developer.

availability.description: "" (not said), open (open to work), freelance or busy.

editOnSite.description: What can't be changed here: the photo, projects, phone, proved GitHub or website.

items.description: A job or a course of studies.

end.description: When it ended, "2023-09"; leave out if it still goes on.

start.description: When it began, as a month: "2021-04".

hasPhone.description: Whether a phone number is on the profile (edited on the site only).

level.description: native, fluent, professional, conversational or basic.

ownProducts.description: Their own products, by slug, to pin or put on a résumé.

pageUrl.description: Their public page on upfork.dev (developers only).

pinnedProducts.description: The products their page leads with, by slug (up to 4 of their own).

projectsElsewhere.description: How many projects outside UpFork are on it (edited on the site, with their pictures).

category.description: Its field: language, frontend, backend, mobile, data, cloud, ai, design, tools or other.

items.description: A link to one of the member's networks.

network.description: linkedin, x, telegram, instagram, youtube, stackoverflow, gitlab, dribbble, behance, devto, medium, virgool, codepen, leetcode, kaggle, huggingface, npm or bluesky.

url.description: The full address of the profile there.

title: Your UpFork profile
